hero.heading: Charlotte County Traditional School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Classes run Aug. 10-May 28. Spring break is Mar. 15-19. Four early-release days and three hurricane make-up reserves are listed.
hero.desktopDescription: The 2026-2027 traditional calendar for Charlotte County Public Schools starts August 10, 2026, and ends May 28, 2027. Spring break is March 15-19. Four early-release dates are listed, including Veterans Day. East Elementary and Sallie Jones follow the separate year-round calendar, while Early Head Start has its own schedule.

editorialSummary.heading: Early dismissals and hurricane make-up dates
paragraphs: The traditional calendar lists four early-release days: September 16 and November 11, 2026, and February 24 and March 31, 2027. Veterans Day is a school day with early dismissal, not a full holiday. Pickup times vary by school. Neither December 18, the end of the first semester, nor May 28, the last student day, is marked for early release.

October 12, January 5 and March 12 are professional days also designated as student hurricane make-up reserves. Students are scheduled to be off unless the district activates a reserve, so those dates should not be treated as guaranteed days off. After the December 21-January 1 winter break, January 4 is a professional day and January 6 is the published return date. Students could return January 5 if that reserve is activated.

Spring break runs March 15-19, with regular classes returning March 22. Good Friday is a separate holiday on March 26, and March 22-25 remain scheduled school days. Families with children at East Elementary or Sallie Jones should check the year-round calendar instead: those schools have spring intersession and return to regular classes March 29.
highlights: Veterans Day is a shortened attendance day

faqs.question: Which Charlotte County schools use the traditional calendar?
faqs.answer: The traditional calendar covers the district's regular student schedule. East Elementary and Sallie Jones Elementary use the separate year-round calendar, and Early Head Start has its own program schedule. Check directly with charter schools or programs that publish separate calendars.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-2027 traditional school year start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last is Friday, May 28, 2027. These are the dates in Charlotte County Public Schools' traditional calendar.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Charlotte County schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter break is December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day, and January 5 is hurricane make-up reserve #2. The published return date is Wednesday, January 6, but students could return January 5 if the reserve is activated.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Traditional-calendar students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22. Friday, March 12 is a separate professional day and possible hurricane make-up date.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday is a student holiday on March 26. However, March 22-25 are regular school days between spring break and Good Friday. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is March 12, 2027 a day off from school?
faqs.answer: March 12 is scheduled as a professional day without student classes, but it is also hurricane make-up reserve #3. The district may require student attendance if it activates that date.

faqs.question: What are the hurricane make-up days for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The traditional calendar identifies October 12, 2026, January 5, 2027, and March 12, 2027 as student hurricane make-up reserves. They are not regular attendance days under the published schedule. Check district announcements before treating them as confirmed days off.

faqs.question: Do students have school on Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is an early-release school day, not a full-day holiday. Students attend but leave earlier than usual.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for Charlotte County schools?
faqs.answer: The traditional calendar lists September 16 and November 11, 2026, and February 24 and March 31, 2027. All four are student attendance days.

faqs.question: What time do schools dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools dismiss at either 12:50 p.m. or 1:10 p.m., depending on the school. Middle schools dismiss at 2:10 p.m. and high schools at 12:10 p.m. The Academy dismisses at 12:40 p.m., and Charlotte Harbor Center at 12:10 p.m. Check your school's bell schedule for updates.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: No early release is marked for December 18. The date ends the second quarter and first semester, but the student calendar does not designate it as a shortened school day.

faqs.question: Is the last day of school, May 28, a half day?
faqs.answer: May 28, 2027 is the last student day, but the traditional calendar does not mark it as early release. Follow the regular dismissal schedule unless your school announces a change.

faqs.question: Which professional days have no classes for students?
faqs.answer: August 18 and November 3, 2026, and January 4, 2027 are professional days without student classes. October 12, January 5 and March 12 also have professional-day designations, but those three dates are conditional hurricane make-up reserves.

faqs.question: What holidays are days off on the traditional school calendar?
faqs.answer: The traditional calendar lists Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027), Presidents Day (February 15, 2027) and Good Friday (March 26, 2027) as student holidays. Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks are listed separately.

faqs.question: When do the quarters and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The first quarter ends October 9, 2026. The second quarter and first semester end December 18. The third quarter ends March 11, 2027, and the fourth quarter and second semester end May 28. These academic markers do not automatically mean a day off or early dismissal.

faqs.question: How many school days are in the 2026-2027 traditional calendar?
faqs.answer: The district's published Student Day Count reaches 180 on May 28, 2027. That count reflects the scheduled calendar and excludes the three conditional hurricane make-up reserves.

faqs.question: Does the calendar show report-card release dates?
faqs.answer: The annual student calendar lists quarter and semester ending dates, but not report-card distribution dates. Check your child's school for report-card schedules.

faqs.question: Are high school graduation dates included?
faqs.answer: No graduation ceremony dates are listed in the traditional student calendar. Check the announcements from Charlotte High, Lemon Bay High or Port Charlotte High for school-specific graduation information.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Charlotte County school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Visit the Charlotte County Public Schools School Calendars page and select the 2026-2027 Traditional Calendar. The district provides separate Year-Round and Early Head Start PDFs. Check district and school notices for any later changes.

faqs.answer: The first student day is Thursday, July 16, 2026, and the last is Friday, May 28, 2027. The district's published year-round calendar contains 180 regular student days.

faqs.question: When is fall intersession for East and Sallie Jones?
faqs.answer: Fall intersession is listed for October 19-30 and November 2, 2026. November 3 is a separate professional day without regular classes. Students are scheduled to return Wednesday, November 4. October 13-16 remain regular school days before the intersession.

faqs.question: Do students have to attend school during fall intersession?
faqs.answer: Regular student classes pause during fall intersession. The annual district PDF does not specify participation requirements for any supplemental intersession program. Check with East Elementary or Sallie Jones about available activities and whether your child has any scheduled participation.

faqs.question: When is spring break for year-round students?
faqs.answer: The named spring break is March 15-19, 2027. March 12 is a separate student day off, and March 22-25 is spring intersession. Good Friday falls on March 26, so regular classes resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Do year-round students have regular classes during spring intersession?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled March 22-25, 2027. Those dates are marked as Spring Intersession, followed by Good Friday on March 26. Regular classes resume March 29. The district calendar does not specify whether separate intersession programs are offered or who would attend them.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday is a student holiday. For year-round schools, it follows the March 22-25 spring intersession. Regular classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is March 12, 2027 a hurricane make-up day for year-round schools?
faqs.answer: No. March 12 is labeled Day Off on the year-round calendar. The third hurricane make-up reserve is Tuesday, February 16, 2027. March 12 carries the make-up designation on the Traditional and Early Head Start calendars instead.

faqs.question: What are the year-round hurricane make-up dates?
faqs.answer: The year-round calendar lists October 12, 2026, January 5, 2027 and February 16, 2027 as student hurricane make-up reserves. They are scheduled without regular student classes unless the district activates them.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for year-round schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026, with regular classes scheduled to resume Monday, November 30. These dates match the traditional district calendar.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do year-round classes resume?
faqs.answer: Winter break is December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day, and January 5 is a conditional hurricane make-up date. The published return is Wednesday, January 6, although activating the reserve could move attendance to January 5.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for East and Sallie Jones?
faqs.answer: The year-round calendar lists September 16 and November 11, 2026, and February 24 and March 31, 2027. These are scheduled attendance days with earlier dismissal.

faqs.question: What time do East and Sallie Jones dismiss students?
faqs.answer: East Elementary's regular hours are 8:40 a.m.-3:10 p.m., with early release at 1:10 p.m. Sallie Jones Elementary's regular hours are 8:20 a.m.-2:50 p.m., with early release at 12:50 p.m. These times follow the district's published bell-time table; check school notices for changes.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday for year-round students?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is an early-release attendance day for East and Sallie Jones. Students attend school and dismiss on the shortened schedule.

faqs.question: When do the year-round trimesters end?
faqs.answer: The first trimester ends October 9, 2026, the second ends February 12, 2027, and the third ends May 28, 2027. A trimester ending does not automatically mean early dismissal or a student holiday.

faqs.question: Which professional days have no regular classes?
faqs.answer: August 4 and August 18, 2026, November 3, 2026, and January 4, 2027 are professional days without student classes. October 12, January 5 and February 16 also have professional-day designations, but those dates may be used for hurricane make-up attendance.

faqs.question: What holidays do East Elementary and Sallie Jones have off?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes on Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027), Presidents Day (February 15, 2027) and Good Friday (March 26, 2027). The calendar also lists Thanksgiving break (November 23-27), winter break (December 21-January 1) and spring break (March 15-19). Fall and spring intersessions are scheduled separately.

faqs.question: Does year-round school mean students attend all summer?
faqs.answer: No. The 2026-2027 year-round student calendar runs from July 16, 2026 through May 28, 2027, with scheduled breaks and intersessions during the school year. It does not show regular student attendance in June 2027.

faqs.question: Does the year-round calendar include report-card release dates?
faqs.answer: The district PDF lists trimester ending dates but does not specify when report cards are distributed. Check East Elementary or Sallie Jones for school-specific reporting information.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official Charlotte County year-round calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Open Charlotte County Public Schools' School Calendars page and select the 2026-2027 Year-Round Calendar. For intersession arrangements, dismissal updates and weather-related changes, follow announcements from your child's school.

about.dataSource: The supplied Early Head Start PDF matches the current official download by SHA-256. The district publishes three separate student calendars, with a November 12, 2025 announcement confirming Board approval. Baker Center’s program descriptions distinguish Early Head Start from Head Start and VPK; elementary and secondary bell times are not applied to EHS.
about.processing: Colors and outlines were inspected against the legend: yellow is an academic boundary, green early release, tan a student day off and orange outline a student hurricane make-up reserve. Only four green dates are early release; no half day is invented on December 18 or May 28. Each of the three reserves is outside confirmed closure IDs and uses the published-schedule attendance flag. December 21-31 and January 1 remain separate official entries. The planning summary connects those dates to January 4 professional day and conditional January 5 without claiming all of that span is a guaranteed holiday. FTE survey weeks, staff dates before opening and after the variant’s final attendance date are excluded. The June 2-18 grid is white with a growing SD count, reaching 193, and the June caption explicitly names June 18 Last Day for Students. June 1 is teacher planning and May 31 Memorial Day. The May caption also says Last Day for Students on May 28. That inconsistent label is preserved on the academic-boundary occurrence and documented in sourceDiscrepancies; the final EHS date is June 18. May 28 remains a scheduled attendance date, not an extra final-day occurrence. The full span has 225 weekdays, 29 confirmed no-class weekdays and three conditional reserves, reconciling to 193 baseline days.
about.updates: Checked the district calendar page and downloaded the three current PDFs October 16, 2026. The district homepage, calendar approval announcement, school bell-time page, East and Sallie Jones information and Baker program page were also reviewed during this update. No later activation of a 2026-2027 hurricane make-up reserve or districtwide calendar revision was verified. The Sallie Jones October 11 message was available in official-site search text; direct page fetches returned an error, so it is supplementary evidence rather than a replacement for the district PDF. On October 20, all three PDFs were downloaded again and matched the recorded SHA-256 hashes; the current calendar links, bell-time table and full Sallie Jones October 11 message were also read. The school message was directly accessible on this check and confirms the October 19-November 3 pause and November 4 return. Earlier review dates remain on other sources that were not rechecked. The Baker Center program page was directly checked October 20: it identifies Early Head Start from birth to age 3, Head Start ages 3-4 and VPK separately.
about.disclaimer: Follow district and school notices before treating a hurricane reserve as a firm day off. Use the calendar for the child’s assigned school or program; school-specific schedules and participant instructions take precedence over assumptions from another variant.

seo.description: Charlotte County's 2026-27 Early Head Start calendar runs Aug. 10-June 18 (193 student days). See school breaks, early-release dates and the official PDF.

hero.heading: Charlotte County Early Head Start Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: First day Aug. 10; last day June 18. Early Head Start continues after traditional schools finish May 28.
hero.desktopDescription: Charlotte County Public Schools' Early Head Start calendar runs from August 10, 2026 through June 18, 2027, with 193 scheduled student days. Although the PDF also labels May 28 as a last day, its June attendance schedule continues through June 18. This calendar is specific to Early Head Start, not every Head Start or VPK class.

editorialSummary.heading: Why Early Head Start continues through June
paragraphs: Early Head Start continues after the traditional district school year ends May 28. Its calendar lists student attendance from June 2 through June 18, 2027. Memorial Day, May 31, and the June 1 teacher planning day come before those June classes. The published Student Day Count increases from 180 on May 28 to 193 on June 18. Families planning childcare should use the Early Head Start dates and check for any later center-specific instructions.

The EHS PDF contains two conflicting last-day labels. May 28 is marked as both the end of the fourth quarter and semester and Last Day for Students. However, the June section continues student attendance through June 18 and also marks that date as the last day. For Early Head Start planning, June 18 is the supported final date. Check with your child's center if it issues a different schedule.

The EHS calendar lists early release on September 16 and November 11, 2026, and February 24 and March 31, 2027, but does not provide program dismissal times. Families should confirm pickup arrangements directly with their center rather than using elementary school bell times.
October 12, January 5 and March 12 are teacher planning days that also serve as possible hurricane make-up dates. Those dates may change to attendance days if the district activates them.

faqs.question: Is this calendar for Early Head Start, Head Start or VPK?
faqs.answer: This calendar is for children enrolled in Charlotte County Public Schools' Early Head Start program. Baker Center lists Early Head Start for children from birth to age 3, Head Start for ages 3-4, and VPK as a separate program. Do not assume those programs follow the same June attendance dates.

faqs.question: When does Early Head Start start and end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026. The EHS calendar continues through Friday, June 18, 2027, with a published total of 193 student days.

faqs.question: Why does the Early Head Start calendar show May 28 as the last day?
faqs.answer: The PDF labels May 28 as a last day alongside the end of the fourth quarter and semester. However, the June calendar continues student attendance and separately marks June 18 as the last day. The Student Day Count also increases from 180 to 193. These entries support June 18 as the final EHS date, despite the conflicting May label.

faqs.question: Does Early Head Start have classes in June 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. The published Early Head Start calendar includes student attendance from June 2 through June 18, 2027. Those dates bring the Student Day Count to 193. Check your child's center for any later schedule changes.

faqs.question: Is there Early Head Start on Memorial Day or June 1?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, May 31, 2027 is Memorial Day, and Tuesday, June 1 is a teacher planning day. Both are marked as days without student classes. Scheduled student attendance resumes Wednesday, June 2.

faqs.question: Is June 18, 2027 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: June 18 is marked as the last student day for Early Head Start, but it is not designated as an early-release day in the PDF. Confirm the final day's pickup arrangements with your center.

faqs.question: What are the Early Head Start early-release dates?
faqs.answer: The four listed dates are September 16 and November 11, 2026, and February 24 and March 31, 2027. All four are scheduled student attendance days with early dismissal.

faqs.question: What time does Early Head Start dismiss children on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The EHS calendar lists early-release dates but does not specify pickup times. Contact your child's center for its dismissal and care arrangements. Elementary, middle and high school dismissal times should not be assumed to apply to Early Head Start.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a holiday for Early Head Start?
faqs.answer: No. November 11, 2026 is listed as an early-release attendance day. Children are scheduled to attend, with the shortened dismissal time to be confirmed by their center.

faqs.question: What are the EHS hurricane make-up dates?
faqs.answer: The Early Head Start calendar lists October 12, 2026, January 5, 2027 and March 12, 2027 as teacher planning days with student hurricane make-up designations. They are scheduled without student classes unless the district activates them for attendance.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Early Head Start?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs from December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day, and January 5 is a teacher planning day and possible hurricane make-up date. The published return is Wednesday, January 6, subject to any activation of the January 5 reserve.

faqs.question: When is Early Head Start spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Children are scheduled to return Monday, March 22. Friday, March 12 is a separate teacher planning day and possible hurricane make-up date, while Good Friday on March 26 is a separate holiday.

faqs.question: Is Early Head Start closed on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. March 26 is a scheduled student holiday. Early Head Start has regular student dates March 22-25 after spring break, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, March 29 after Good Friday.

faqs.question: Does Early Head Start have spring intersession on March 22-25?
faqs.answer: No. The Early Head Start calendar does not list the year-round schools' March 22-25 intersession. Those dates remain scheduled EHS student days. The year-round intersession applies to a different student calendar.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Early Head Start?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026. The scheduled return is Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: What holidays and breaks does Early Head Start have?
faqs.answer: The EHS calendar lists Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027), Presidents Day (February 15), Good Friday (March 26) and Memorial Day (May 31) as student holidays. Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27, winter break December 21-January 1, and spring break March 15-19. Teacher planning days and conditional hurricane make-up dates are listed separately.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning or professional days have no EHS classes?
faqs.answer: August 18 and November 3, 2026, and January 4 and June 1, 2027 are scheduled without student classes. October 12, January 5 and March 12 also have planning-day designations, but those dates are conditional hurricane make-up reserves.

faqs.question: Does the Early Head Start calendar have 180 or 193 student days?
faqs.answer: It lists 193 scheduled student days. The count reaches 180 by May 28, then continues through June 18. The 193-day total excludes the three conditional hurricane make-up reserves.

faqs.question: Do Early Head Start children have class on May 28, 2027?
faqs.answer: May 28 remains a scheduled student day in the published EHS calendar, with the Student Day Count reaching 180. Although the PDF also labels it as a last day, student attendance continues into June and ends June 18. Confirm any later center-specific changes.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Early Head Start calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Visit the Charlotte County Public Schools School Calendars page and select the 2026-2027 Early Head Start calendar. For enrollment-specific schedules, pickup times or updates, contact your child's Early Head Start center.
